name: Tesseract Decks & Designs
description: Lays out what the assistant writes as slide decks with speaker notes, diagrams (Mermaid or SVG), charts with their numbers in a table, and designs from HTML/CSS or SVG, kept as private pages in the person's Tesseract account with earlier versions. Calls no AI model and costs nothing on any Tesseract plan. 6 tools (4 make or change a page, 2 read back pages made here). OAuth sign-in with a free Tesseract account; hosted by Eightcell Labs, closed source.
author: Eightcell Labs, Inc.
